description: THE source for pharma/device industry money to doctors — "payments from manufacturers to physicians", "which drug companies paid this doctor", "Sunshine Act data", "industry payments to hospitals". Search one CMS Open Payments program-year dataset using structured recipient, company, product, geography, payment-nature, and amount filters. CAPABILITY LIMIT, state it rather than guessing: this source can look up and filter but CANNOT rank ALL manufacturers by total spend ("which manufacturer paid the most" is not computable live — the 14M-row aggregation times out upstream); answer those by saying so and offering a named-company lookup (open_payments_company) instead. CMS publishes company-reported relationships; a payment does not imply wrongdoing or a conflict.

product.description: Case-insensitive associated-product substring across all five product fields.

recipient_first_name.description: Exact recipient first name, to disambiguate a common surname (e.g. last_name "PATEL" + first_name "RIPAL").

recipient_last_name.description: Exact recipient last name. CMS stores names uppercase; case is normalized for you. Pair with recipient_first_name — a common surname alone matches many practitioners.

year.description: Program year (2019-current published year; default latest).

name: open_payments_search
title: Open Payments Search
